common.CPG: shared historical command2 drive+turn, no joint residual

reward.legacy: Original v_projected_on_initial_heading -20*abs(heading_error), failure -1000. Same new observation/seed/targets/finite horizon as aligned branch. This is an objective control, not an exact old training reproduction.
reward.aligned: scripts/task.py: 2cos(error) plus capped gait-averaged body-forward speed benefit; near-goal gait-averaged yaw cost; posture/action costs; push lateral cost. Terminal success +5, unsuccessful survival -2, physical failure -5.

common.success: Full2s horizon; last20micro10ms samples satisfy original heading/up/speed gate. Macro samples are not the success window.

primary_endpoints.push: failure-adjusted abs heading error integral over0.5s after force end; final joint walking-heading stability
primary_endpoints.angle: final absolute heading error; final sustained walking-angle success

promotion: At any registered nonzero fixed budget, screen using the original joint gate; then train two fresh seeds3002/3003. Not a claim; no six-seed expansion before reproducibility.

development_revision_before_formal_train.reason: Untrained CPG and fixed PD traces show normal gait yaw RMS about5-6rad/s despite heading remaining within10deg. Remove provisional1.5rad/s RMS gate; average yaw/speed over0.1s for observations/shaping. No learned evaluation was used. Retain original calibration traces and provisional smoke runs.

candidate_rule.push: At1024,2048,4096or8192macro decisions: Adult AUC<=0.85*MLP and<=0.85*CPG, success no worse than both, physical failure no worse than MLP. Triggers two seeds, not a superiority claim.
candidate_rule.angle: At1024,2048,4096or8192macro decisions: Adult mean failure-adjusted angle error at least5deg below MLP and CPG, success no worse than both, physical failure no worse than MLP. Triggers two seeds, not a superiority claim.

potential_shaping.reason: At8192, both angle policies remain near CPG-only mean60deg although fixed feedback achieves5.27deg. Test denser temporal credit while preserving the discounted episodic objective. No teacher and no architecture-specific reward.
potential_shaping.invariance: Discounted shaping sum is -phi_initial when terminal phi=0. Here initial heading error is0; total discounted episodic return is unchanged for any fixed complete trajectory.
potential_shaping.comparison: Same micro reward asPT04. This branch adds held actions, macro discount/rollout conversion and four held-input neural substeps. Each within-branch model is trained from scratch.
potential_shaping.normalization_caveat: Trajectory-return identity is for raw rewards. Running reward normalization, finite-horizon GAE and approximate critic training can change optimization dynamics.
potential_shaping.budget_caveat: 4xmacro count is a nominal upper bound on10ms physical steps; early failure can truncate a hold. Both models have identical macro decision budgets.
potential_shaping.gamma_scope: Applied at each10ms microstep; macro gamma is micro_gamma**4.

action_hold.motivation: Archived hexapod interface holds decisions40ms; current fly command interface updates10ms. Test persistent exploration with matched physical interaction budget.
action_hold.neural_rule: Four internal substeps each withgate0.5; same recurrence as four old10ms steps for constant observations. Inputs held across these substeps; no claim of identical observation history.
action_hold.ppo_rule: Same32updates and nominal rollout/sequence duration asPT04; gamma/lambda converted to40ms.
action_hold.interpretation: Within-branch equal macro decision budgets. Four-times physical-equivalent counts are nominal upper bounds: early failure may use fewer than4microsteps. Neural inputs held across four internal substeps.

changes: Four10ms physical task steps per action
Discount-consistent aggregation of already-shaped micro rewards
Neural recurrence integrates four held-input substeps

stopping: Fixed sample size; do not stop or extend based on interim P values.

er.family: ER-SD fixed-M directed uniform random graph
